# Import data
```{r}
# Define function to read in chl data
read_chl <- function(file) {
  chl_data <- read_csv(file, skip = 24, n_max = 24) %>%
    select(-1) %>%
    magrittr::set_colnames(c("row", 1:12, "wavelength")) %>%
    fill(row) %>%
    gather("col", "absorbance", -wavelength, -row) %>%
    unite("well", c(row, col), sep = "")
}

# List chlorophyll data files
chl_path <- "data/chlorophyll/"                                        # Path to chlorophyll data directory
all_chl_files <- list.files(path = chl_path, pattern = "*.csv")          # List all files in directory
chl_platemaps <- list.files(path = chl_path, pattern = "platemap")       # List platemap files
chl_data_files <- setdiff(all_chl_files, chl_platemaps)                  # List absorbance data files

# Read in all files into tibble
df <- tibble(file = chl_data_files) %>%
  mutate(platemap = map(file, ~ read_csv(paste0(chl_path, tools::file_path_sans_ext(.), "_platemap.csv"))),
         chl_data = map(file, ~ read_chl(paste0(chl_path, .))))

# Merge platemap and data for each plate
df <- df %>%
  mutate(merged = map2(platemap, chl_data, ~ right_join(.x, .y)))
```

# Calculate chlorophyll concentrations
```{r}
# average all technical replicates for each plate/sample/wavelength, including all acetone blanks together (per plate)
df <- df %>%
  unnest(merged) %>%
  filter(!is.na(colony_id)) %>%                         # remove empty wells (colony_id is NA)
  group_by(file, colony_id, wavelength) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_abs = mean(absorbance)) %>%
  spread(wavelength, mean_abs)

# get the acetone blank 750 absorbance for each file (i.e., plate), and subtract from 630 and 663 values for each sample
df <- df %>%
  group_by(file) %>%
  mutate(blank750 = `750`[colony_id == "BK"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(adj630 = `630` - blank750,
         adj663 = `663` - blank750)

# calculate chla and chlc2 values based on equations from Jeffrey and Humphrey 1975
# units µg/ml
#path length adjustment = 0.6 

df <- df %>%
  mutate(chla.ug.ml = (11.43 * adj663)/0.6 - (0.64 * adj630)/0.6,
        chlc2.ug.ml = (27.09 * adj630)/0.6 - (3.63 * adj663)/0.6)

# Check for missing values
df %>% filter(is.na(chla.ug.ml))

# Distribution
summary(df$chla.ug.ml)
ggplot(df, aes(x = chla.ug.ml)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_rug()

# Flag outliers by IQR
chl_iqr_fence <- quantile(df$chla.ug.ml, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) +
  1.5 * IQR(df$chla.ug.ml, na.rm = TRUE)
df %>% filter(chla.ug.ml > chl_iqr_fence) %>% arrange(desc(chla.ug.ml))

# Check for duplicate colony_id
chl.dups <- df %>% count(colony_id) %>% filter(n > 1)

# For duplicates, keep the most recent plate run (file names are YYYYMMDD-prefixed,
# so arranging descending retains the latest re-run over earlier measurements).
# January 2026 plates (Plate10, 12, 13) were intentional re-runs of November 2025 originals.
# August 2026 plates (Plate15, 16; run 2026-08-13) were a further re-run of 5 colonies:
#   AS-B9z, MH-B6, MH-E7z, PG-E6, PV-B1 — August values retained as the authoritative measurement.
df <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(file)) %>%
  distinct(colony_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Confirm duplicates resolved
chl.dups <- df %>% count(colony_id) %>% filter(n > 1)

write_csv(df, path = "output/chlorophyll_list.csv")

```


# Normalize to surface area
```{r}
# Load homogenate volume
homog.vol <- read_csv("data/homogenate_vols.csv") %>%
  select(colony_id, homog_vol_ml)

# Check for missing values
homog.vol %>% filter(is.na(homog_vol_ml))

# Distribution
summary(homog.vol$homog_vol_ml)
ggplot(homog.vol, aes(x = homog_vol_ml)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_rug()

# Flag outliers by IQR
homog_iqr_fence <- quantile(homog.vol$homog_vol_ml, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) +
  1.5 * IQR(homog.vol$homog_vol_ml, na.rm = TRUE)
homog.vol %>% filter(homog_vol_ml > homog_iqr_fence) %>% arrange(desc(homog_vol_ml))

homog.dups <- homog.vol %>% count(colony_id) %>% filter(n > 1)
homog.vol <- homog.vol %>% filter(!colony_id %in% homog.dups$colony_id)
homog.vol %>% count(colony_id) %>% filter(n > 1)

chl <- full_join(df, homog.vol)

# Load surface area
sa <- read_csv("output/surface_area_calculated.csv")

# Check for missing values
sa %>% filter(is.na(surface.area.cm2))

sa.dups <- sa %>% count(colony_id) %>% filter(n > 1)
sa <- sa %>% filter(!colony_id %in% sa.dups$colony_id)
sa %>% count(colony_id) %>% filter(n > 1)

# Distribution
summary(sa$surface.area.cm2)
ggplot(sa, aes(x = surface.area.cm2)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_rug()

# Flag outliers by IQR
sa_iqr_fence <- quantile(sa$surface.area.cm2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) +
  1.5 * IQR(sa$surface.area.cm2, na.rm = TRUE)
sa %>% filter(surface.area.cm2 > sa_iqr_fence) %>% arrange(desc(surface.area.cm2))

chl <- full_join(chl, sa)

# Extraction volumes — 0.5 mL homogenate subsampled and extracted into 1.0 mL acetone
homog_sample_vol_ml <- 0.5
acetone_vol_ml      <- 1.0

# Scale: chl (µg/mL acetone) × acetone vol → total chl in subsample
#        ÷ homog subsample vol × homog vol  → total chl in full homogenate
#        ÷ surface area                     → µg/cm²
chl <- chl %>%
  mutate(chla.ug.cm2  = chla.ug.ml  * (acetone_vol_ml / homog_sample_vol_ml) * homog_vol_ml / surface.area.cm2,
         chlc2.ug.cm2 = chlc2.ug.ml * (acetone_vol_ml / homog_sample_vol_ml) * homog_vol_ml / surface.area.cm2)

# remove blanks and NAs
chl <- filter(chl, !colony_id %in% c("NA", "BK"))

# write chlorophyll data to file
chl %>%
  select(colony_id, chla.ug.cm2, chlc2.ug.cm2) %>%
  #mutate(timepoint="timepoint1")%>%
  filter(!is.na(chla.ug.cm2))%>%
  filter(!is.na(chlc2.ug.cm2))%>%
  write_csv(path = "output/chlorophyll.csv")
```

# Plot results by species and site
```{r, eval = TRUE}
# Join with sample metadata
meta <- read_csv("data/Master_Sample_List.csv")
meta <- meta %>%
  filter(Replicate!="t0")%>%
  filter(Date.Sampled.Tank!="NA")

chl <- right_join(chl, meta, by = "colony_id")

# Plot chlorophyll a
chl %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Date.Sampled.Tank), y = chla.ug.cm2, color = species)) +
  facet_wrap(~species, scales="free") +
  labs(x = "", y = "chlorophyll a (µg/cm2)") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1) +                                            # Plot all points
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, fun.args = list(mult = 1),    # Plot standard error
               geom = "errorbar", color = "black", width = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "point", color = "black") +          # Plot mean
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))

# Plot chlorophyll c2
chl %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Date.Sampled.Tank), y = chlc2.ug.cm2, color = species)) +
  facet_wrap(~species, scales="free") +
  labs(x = "", y = "chlorophyll c2 (µg/cm2)") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1) +                                            # Plot all points
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, fun.args = list(mult = 1),    # Plot standard error
               geom = "errorbar", color = "black", width = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "point", color = "black") +          # Plot mean
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))
```


#outlier check
#check for outliers per species and diagnose if they are outliers in homogenate volume, surface area, or chlorophyll value
```{r}
# Flag outliers per species using 1.5x IQR rule for each component variable
is_outlier <- function(x) {
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q[2] - q[1]
  x < (q[1] - 1.5 * iqr) | x > (q[2] + 1.5 * iqr)
}

outlier_check <- chl %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(
    out_chla_raw     = is_outlier(chla.ug.ml),
    out_chlc2_raw    = is_outlier(chlc2.ug.ml),
    out_homog_vol    = is_outlier(homog_vol_ml),
    out_surface_area = is_outlier(surface.area.cm2),
    out_chla_norm    = is_outlier(chla.ug.cm2),
    out_chlc2_norm   = is_outlier(chlc2.ug.cm2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Samples flagged as outliers in any variable
flagged <- outlier_check %>%
  filter(out_chla_raw | out_chlc2_raw |
           out_chla_norm | out_chlc2_norm) %>%
  select(colony_id, species,
         chla.ug.ml, chlc2.ug.ml,
         chla.ug.cm2, chlc2.ug.cm2,
         out_chla_raw, out_chlc2_raw,
         out_chla_norm, out_chlc2_norm) %>%
  arrange(species, colony_id)

print(flagged)

# Summary: count of outlier flags per species and variable
outlier_check %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total          = n(),
    n_out_chla_raw   = sum(out_chla_raw,     na.rm = TRUE),
    n_out_chlc2_raw  = sum(out_chlc2_raw,    na.rm = TRUE),
    n_out_chla_norm  = sum(out_chla_norm,    na.rm = TRUE),
    n_out_chlc2_norm = sum(out_chlc2_norm,   na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
# Remove samples flagged as extreme high outliers in raw chlorophyll values
chl_clean <- outlier_check %>%
  filter(!(out_chla_raw))

# Plot chlorophyll a after outlier removal
chl_clean %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Date.Sampled.Tank), y = chla.ug.cm2, color = species)) +
  facet_wrap(~species, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "", y = "chlorophyll a (µg/cm2)", title = "Chlorophyll a — outliers removed") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, fun.args = list(mult = 1),
               geom = "errorbar", color = "black", width = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "point", color = "black") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

# Plot chlorophyll c2 after outlier removal
chl_clean %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Date.Sampled.Tank), y = chlc2.ug.cm2, color = species)) +
  facet_wrap(~species, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "", y = "chlorophyll c2 (µg/cm2)", title = "Chlorophyll c2 — outliers removed") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, fun.args = list(mult = 1),
               geom = "errorbar", color = "black", width = 0.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom = "point", color = "black") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
```
